description: Sally Textile Mills Limited is a yarn spinning company whose mill at Jauharabad, on the Muzaffargarh Road in Khushab district, Punjab, manufactures cotton, blended and synthetic yarn in a range of counts. Its yarn is consumed locally by weaving and knitwear manufacturers. The company's own site describes it as being among the leaders in creating, developing and manufacturing high quality yarn products.
